title: 石子游戏 VII
summary: 两人轮流移除两端石子，获得移除后剩余石子总和，双方最优；求 Alice 与 Bob 最终分差。
insight: 区间 DP 直接记录当前玩家从区间 [left,right] 开始能取得的最大净胜分。移除一端的即时得分减去对手在剩余区间的净胜分，二者取大。
pitfalls: 得分是移除后剩余石子之和
DP 值是当前玩家相对对手的分差
单石区间无法获得分数，状态为零

solutions.title: 区间分差动态规划
solutions.idea: 用零和博弈的净胜分消去玩家维度。
steps: 前缀和支持区间求和，dp 单点为零

code.java: class Solution { public int stoneGameVII(int[] stones){int n=stones.length;int[] prefix=new int[n+1];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)prefix[i+1]=prefix[i]+stones[i];int[][] dp=new int[n][n];for(int length=2;length<=n;length++)for(int left=0;left+length<=n;left++){int right=left+length-1;int removeLeft=prefix[right+1]-prefix[left+1]-dp[left+1][right];int removeRight=prefix[right]-prefix[left]-dp[left][right-1];dp[left][right]=Math.max(removeLeft,removeRight);}return dp[0][n-1];} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun stoneGameVII(stones:IntArray):Int{val n=stones.size;val prefix=IntArray(n+1);for(i in stones.indices)prefix[i+1]=prefix[i]+stones[i];val dp=Array(n){IntArray(n)};for(length in 2..n)for(left in 0..n-length){val right=left+length-1;val removeLeft=prefix[right+1]-prefix[left+1]-dp[left+1][right];val removeRight=prefix[right]-prefix[left]-dp[left][right-1];dp[left][right]=maxOf(removeLeft,removeRight)};return dp[0][n-1]} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int stoneGameVII(vector<int>& stones){int n=stones.size();vector<int> prefix(n+1);for(int i=0;i<n;++i)prefix[i+1]=prefix[i]+stones[i];vector<vector<int>> dp(n,vector<int>(n));for(int length=2;length<=n;++length)for(int left=0;left+length<=n;++left){int right=left+length-1;int removeLeft=prefix[right+1]-prefix[left+1]-dp[left+1][right];int removeRight=prefix[right]-prefix[left]-dp[left][right-1];dp[left][right]=max(removeLeft,removeRight);}return dp[0][n-1];} };
